aus.claim: Unless there is evidence to the contrary, the police force is the only institution mandated with the protection of a nation's citizens and in possession of enforcement powers commensurate with this mandate.
aus.limits: Alternate institutions do not constitute avenues of protection per se.

evidence.quote:
[25]
I am of the view that these alternate institutions do not constitute avenues of protection
per se
; unless there is evidence to the contrary, the police force is the only institution mandated with the protection of a nation's citizens and in possession of enforcement powers commensurate with this mandate.

aus.claim: The National Human Rights Commission has no legal power of enforcement.

evidence.quote: For example, the documentary evidence explicitly states that the National Human Rights Commission has no legal power of enforcement ("Mexico: Situation of Witness to Crime and Corruption, Women Victims of Violence and Victims of Discrimination Based on Sexual Orientation").
